fusions.name: Barbed Sacrifice
fusions.desc: Looses a barbed mote that deals 9 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Pollinate
fusions.desc: Looses 4 motes of arcana at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 4 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Glimmer Swarm
fusions.desc: After a 1 second cast, calls up a swarm of arcane motes that fights for 15 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Never Idle
fusions.desc: When your mana runs out, you restore 3 mana a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
